narrative.overview: The page is a slab poured from square tiles. Hard rectangular plates of formwork, concrete and rust stack down the page, each one a full-bleed ground that sets every colour sitting on it. Content is ruled, not carded. The same tile is bullet, status mark, simulator cell and wordmark piece. Headings are tall, condensed and heavy in sentence case; everything else is monospaced. There is no radius, shadow or gradient anywhere in the shipped build.
keyCharacteristics: Full-width plates in dark, light and rust, alternating down the page.
Square tiles (0 radius) as bullets, marks, cells and buttons.
Ruled structure (1px and 2px lines) in place of cards and shadows.
Condensed 800-weight display headings over an all-mono body.
Fixed spacing and type step scales; nothing is sized off-scale.
One authored motion moment plus one scroll-driven word reveal; everything else is static.

rules.name: The Plate Sets Everything Rule
rules.body: A plate class defines --bg, --fg, --fg-2, --accent, --rule, --tile and --focus together. Components read those variables and never hard-code a colour that depends on the ground behind them.

rules.name: The Two Rusts Rule
rules.body: Rust (#C23A17) appears only on concrete; rust-hot (#E8601F) appears only on formwork. On the rust plate the accent becomes formwork. A close tile inside the rust plate resets to the dark variables so rust-hot is legal inside it.

rules.name: The Slab Is Decoration Rule
rules.body: Slab (#8F8B82) never carries meaning, text or state.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: All headings, labels and buttons are sentence case. There is no uppercase transform and no letter-spacing on any role.

rules.name: The Step Scale Rule
rules.body: Type sizes come from one fixed set (0.75, 0.875, 1, 1.125, 1.25, 1.5, 1.875, 2.25, 3, 3.75, 4.5, 6 rem). Display sizes are fluid clamps between two steps.

rules.name: The Flat Slab Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats. The only layered element is the copy tooltip, which is an opaque rust-hot tile.

dos: Do put every new surface on a plate and read colour from the plate variables.
Do use rust-hot (#E8601F) on formwork and rust (#C23A17) on concrete, and nowhere else.
Do keep tiles square at radius 0, with state carried by fill, ring or dashed ring plus a text label.
Do build structure from 1px and 2px rules instead of cards.
Do take every space and type size from the fixed step scales.
Do write headings and buttons in sentence case with Big Shoulders Display 800 for headings and JetBrains Mono for everything else.
Do keep a visible pause for looping motion and make it still under prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't add radius, box-shadow, gradient or blur to any element.
Don't use slab (#8F8B82) as a text or fill colour.
Don't place rust-hot on concrete or rust on formwork.
Don't reach for the default AI-infrastructure look: a dark gradient page, glowing cards or a row of hero metrics.
Don't convey state by colour alone; pair it with shape or text.
